questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: A reaction happens in an open test tube and releases a gas. Why might the measured mass appear to drop, even though mass is truly conserved?
questions.why: Mass is always conserved, but in an open system the gas product can escape into the air, so the mass left behind in the container appears smaller.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: What is it called when a solid suddenly appears as two liquids react together?
questions.why: A precipitate is a solid that forms unexpectedly when two liquids react, showing a new substance has been made.
